prompt:

A full-body photograph in the Court of the Lions at the Alhambra with a pale marble floor, slender arcade columns, standard-height arched doorways and a low fountain, empty of visitors, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Samoan man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth warm brown skin, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a lead miniature anvil, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver hammer head, a silver square-sided cowbell, a silver ship's anchor, an iron barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal anklet. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
